auth: Requires a Bearer token for the current authenticated user, unless noted.

endpoints.description: Lists pending team invitations addressed to the current user (matched by phone number), shown right after signup so an invited staff/front-desk member can join their business.
issues: REQUESTED (P1): invitations are only matched by exact phone string (TeamInvitation.phone == user.phone), and users without a phone get none. So an invite sent by email never reaches anyone, anyone who signed up with Google (no phone) never sees one, and a number saved in a different format doesn't match. Please match pending invitations to the user by email OR phone, comparing phones normalised to E.164 (as customers already are). That way an invite shows up right after the person registers, verifies or signs in with Google using that email or phone. The app shows invites on Get Started and the Profile tab, routes an invited user to Get Started after login, and until this is fixed tells users without a phone to add one.

endpoints.description: Post-publish equivalent of business-setup.json#invite-team-member (onboarding's Team invite step), but collects the fuller field set that step never asked for: name, commission split, and working days. At least one of email/phone is required. An invitation IS the team roster record — there's no separate 'member' entity — so this returns the same shape list-my-invitations/get-business-profile-style team lists would use.

endpoints.description: Edits a team member's commission split and/or working days. Works the same whether the member's invitation is still pending or already accepted — no separate 'accepted member' record exists to edit instead. Only the fields sent are changed; send workingDays: null to clear it. Returns the full member.

notes: 2026-09-26 (BK-02): members carry staffId, which is null while the invitation is pending and set once accepted. It's the same id as the business profile's staff[].staffId, and it's the id bookings, availability and earnings use. Editing commission/working days still goes through PATCH /team/members/{invitationId}; the server keeps the staff record in sync. Only accepted members (non-null staffId) are bookable.
